turns: We are removing the rate limiter from the public API. It has never fired in production.

The limiter has never fired because it sits behind our CDN, which already enforces 100 requests per second per IP and has its own limiter with alerting. The origin is not reachable except through the CDN, enforced by mTLS. So the app-level limiter is a second copy of a control we already have and cannot be bypassed.
